spans.text: ❌ **Never auto-satisfy without evidence** — don't mark SATISFIED just because a skill ran; verify the results actually answer the question.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly prohibits hallucinating data and requires that responses reference only facts found in actual skill results. It also requires evidence-based satisfaction assessment rather than assuming answers without verification.

spans.text: ❌ **Never repeat skills without cause** — if opensearch_querier just ran, don't queue it again unless the parameters fundamentally change.
spans.note: The prompt includes multiple safeguards for tool and action safety. It enforces least-privilege skill execution, guards against infinite loops, prevents running all skills at once, and requires clear and actionable parameters before executing skills.
